_comment: minLines/minTokens sit above import-prelude size ON PURPOSE. rustfmt normalises `use` ordering, so every module importing anyhow+chrono+serde_json ends up with a byte-identical 3-line block; at minLines 3 / minTokens 15 that registered as 21 clones and made `cargo fmt` and this gate mutually exclusive. threshold stays 0 — the gate still fails on any real duplicated logic, which is what it was added for.
